reviews.text: Huge shoutout to the groomer on duty yesterday afternoon (15/08)—she did an exceptional job! My Chihuahua looks absolutely stunning. The trimming was neat, precise, and completely even throughout. Her attention to detail really showed, and my dog came home looking and feeling fantastic. Highly recommend!!!

Came in with my 10 year old partially blind and deaf chihuahua (Pandora Lopez) who doesn’t like being touched by anyone but Ariana was so nice and gentle with her she ended up not wanting to leave the shop! They all made Pandora feel very welcome which was very refreshing to see. Will be coming back! Thanks again Ariana!

I called to ask questions about a dog I’m planning to get, and they were extremely helpful. They took the time to answer everything I needed and explained what they have available for pet dogs. They really guided me through what to consider and made everything easy to understand. Great customer service and very supportive staff. I would definitely recommend them.
Amazing groom, I genuinely think the best one ever. Picked up a very happy, cute dog. Highly recommend Amy.
The ladyship behind the desk was very helpful with my inquiry and ask me 2 take the dog there ao that they can give me a better price
Love this place - kind service, and they did a beautiful groom to our Cocker who is not easy to style with all his hair! Loved the little ponytail touch.
Thank you for grooming Ras and Tiny. Amazing and lovely staff and a clear passion and love for animals. They were very quick too! So happy with both of my pups. Will 100% be going back.
Excellent

Amy did a lovely groom on Alfie. She was very sweet and patient with him and he looked gorgeous afterwards. She was knowledgeable about his health issues and had a very caring approach. I will definitely be going back to Love That Paw.

I took my dog called Chai to have a full hair cut , my chai felt very relaxing and happy.

The lady ( forgot her name!! I think she’s called Amy !) did exactly what I asked for, chai looks beautiful!! I felt that the staff really likes dogs and don’t do it only for the money!

I recommend!

Such a great experience. Amy and Ariana were incredibly kind and handled Winnie so gently. She smells amazing and is the softest she’s ever been. You can really tell she was well looked after. Highly recommend 💗 …
Amazing service and grooming ! Very happy with this new place

Amy was so kind to my dog Freddie (who can be a little bit nervous of the dryer and doesn’t love getting groomed) - but every time we walk past he pulls me to go in which says it all really. Will be booking him in again!
A lovely shop with the nicest people- it’s great to have another small business owner on Flask Walk to support. Great selection of high quality dog food and treats, toys, etc.
A lovely little shop for your four-legged friend. They have everything a dog could possibly want. Customers receive friendly service. The shop is definitely worth a visit.
By far and away the best groomer I've been to in london for my toy cavapoo. Always so friendly and able to squeeze us in last minute when in need of a quick tidy up!
Lovely Amy groomed and styled my two Shihtzus beautifully. She was friendly and helpful and my dogs were very happy. Would definitely recommend.

had some issues on the begining but the owner was reactive and solved it quickly.
couldn't be happier with recent grooming!
definitely  recommending!

I have used Love That Paw twice now for a full groom for my extra large dog. They have done a great job each time and have shown him love and kindness as well as being responsive and flexible towards me. I would recommend them.

We used to be regular customers of this store, and the staff had always been friendly. A while ago we bought an expensive dog lead (65 GBP) which after a few months of use broke. We promptly returned it to the shop and asked for it to be replaced. This was refused with the argument of "wear and tear", which I can sort of understand given that we had used the lead for a while.

We then (stupidly) bought the exact same lead from them again, which then broke at the same spot after just a few days of use. We called the shop immediately but weren't able to return it immediately since we were on extended travels. Upon our return, they again refused to replace the lead, arguing that it had been some time since we bought it (although we called about it immediately).

I am not sure if they have a legal right to refuse replacing the lead, but it just blows my mind that you would treat a regular customer like that (given that this has happened twice and the leads are clearly defective) and prefer to get a 1 star review on google, rather than doing the right thing and replace at least one of those leads.
Took Artemis for her first groom at Love That Paw!  We were delighted with the experience and looking forward to our next visit!

Amy was absolutely lovely, took time to establish exactly what was needed, was generous with her time and input and went to great effort to return my Wirehaired sausage dog looking beautiful and perfect. Calm wonderful atmosphere. Thank you

I'm so so happy that I found Love That Paw 🐾 Aside from the amusing name (!) the staff are all sensational. That's a big word but it truly represents them 🙏🏽

My cavapoo is gorgeous on the outside but her breath made me want to re-home her. Id tried two different teeth cleaning places but the pooch was traumatised even though they seemed very nice.

For the sake of the breathable atmosphere in our home, I tried Love That Paw.

Amy was just a sheet delight from the start with nervous shaking creature. On their first 1-2-1 session, Amy managed to calm her enough that they got rid of huge amounts of plaque and she even let her use the metal scraper on her teeth.

We had the 3rd session today (3 in 3 weeks for £95 which is really reasonable) and the dawg's teeth are really white, gums are pink (not red) and I can finally give her a kiss without holding my breath.

I truly cannot thank Amy enough for her patience and kindness with my little dog and for helping us avoid putting her under risky anesthetic at the very to get them cleaned.

Took my Pomeranian, Tank here. He looks and smells great. All the staff are really patient and skilled at what they do. Natalia gave him a full groom and he came out looking swish! He’s full of beans and ready to roll. Definitely our new groomer 👍 …

DO NOT BRING YOUR DOG HERE FOR GROOMING.EVER I have a wonderful show cocker that needs to be professionally groomed and stripped. I was assured that they knew standards for this type of grooming. I got told that grooming would have taken 4h and I had no issue with it I picked up a badly scissored dog (a 20 min job)  with holes in her hears and when I arrived home I also found she was cutted and bleeding!!! I am hart-broken on how the dog has been treated. SHAME ON THIS SO CALLED BUSINESS

Our 9 year old rescue dog Rusty has been here several times for grooming and teeth cleaning and always comes out looking 5 years younger. The staff are really lovely and caring and the new pretty young blonde lady who now handles the grooming is so helpful and does a thorough job for anything you may request. The shop also has some unique bespoke leads, collars and accessories along with quality dog treats. Highly recommended you won’t be disappointed.To be found at the end of Flask Walk opposite The Flask Pub.
Amy did a great job on our goldendoodle, asking lots of questions and making him comfortable. Thank you! We’ll be back!
Great place. I love that they take the time to know me and my pup. They have great treats to purchase as well. I (LOVE) Love That Paw.
Awesome
So happy with my dogs groom! Lovely shop and friendly staff. Will be coming back soon!
Great grooming! The staff were very friendly and helpful. Definitely recommend!
I love this shop. My dog goes for grooming. The staff are very nice. And all very caring.
Very friendly staff!
Average experience.

The groomer cut my dog on his genitals while grooming! He developed an infection and had to get antibiotic treatment from the vet. After informing them I am still waiting for some acknowledgment and action from them! Very disappointed and my SamSun is suffering so much! Please be aware!

We’ve been taking out doodle here since they opened last year and can not fault the care they provide.

She’s always very happy and comfortable when I come to pick her up. They’ve done a wonderful full groom (despite her being extremely matted from muddy walks and rain) - the groomer communicated well and did a great job all round.

Would highly recommend - our doodle pulls us into the shop for balls and tummy rubs whenever we walk past!!
